caption: The drawing depicts a figure nailed to a wooden cross. The cross is rendered in shades of gray and brown with a rectangular, three-dimensional appearance. At the top of the cross, there is a sign labeled "INRI" in black text on a white background. The figure on the cross is wearing a green and yellow cloth with diagonal stripes around the waist and is otherwise unclothed. The figure has a beard, mustache, and long hair depicted in black, and a crown made of dark spikes is placed on the head. The figure's body is marked with numerous red lines and spots, representing wounds, and blood is shown on the forehead, torso, arms, and legs. Nails are depicted in both hands and both feet, pinning the figure to the cross. The background is plain and uncolored, consisting only of the off-white paper surface. At the bottom right corner, the artist's signature and location "MARTÍN G. CLAFUÉ - TAOS." are inscribed.
title: Cruciform - Bulto
